items: `customElements.define` registers a hyphenated tag name with its class. Register a given name only once per document.
`attachShadow` creates the component's internal shadow root. Open mode allows access through its `shadowRoot` property.
A slot marks where caller-supplied content is displayed. Text inside a slot is fallback content when that slot is empty.
